Questions & answers

Your questions.
Clear answers.

Wondering how Paktum fits your team? Let’s take a look together.

Talk to us↗
Who is Paktum built for?

Paktum is used by sports clubs, marketing agencies, leagues and federations, from regional clubs to the top leagues. In your demo, we’ll look at your team’s workflows and requirements.

Meet our customers↗
Can we bring our existing Excel data?

Our team helps you migrate from Excel and the tools you use today. Our described onboarding process takes up to three to four weeks; we’ll work out the scope together.

Read the migration guide↗
Can Paktum connect to our accounting software?

Paktum offers interfaces to connect existing systems. We’ll review the accounting and CRM tools you use and discuss how to set up the data exchange.

Discuss your integrations↗
How is pricing structured?

The licensing model is based on your sponsorship volume and the package you choose. You’ll find the current packages and included features on our pricing page.

Compare packages↗
What does Rollo do?

Rollo is Paktum’s AI assistant. It helps with data quality and finding gaps in your data. Our blog shows how it has also been used to extract a customer’s contract data from PDFs.

Meet Rollo in practice↗
